title: Do Men and Women See Differently?
content: Do men and women see differently? According to a recent studyreported in National Geographic, they do.Women are better at distinguishing colors, particularly in the blue and green range of the spectrum. Men excel at tracking fast-moving objects and discriminating details at a distance. The difference in men's vision apparently comes from how visual neurons develop in a high testosterone environment.Men and Women Really Do See Differently -- National GeographicPhoto by Rachel Sarai on FlickrPreviously on GJ:Men, Women, and Eyetracking
